resources.string: Shizuku isn\'t connected. Start the Shizuku service from the home screen, then try again.

ADB/shell mode detected. If your device restricts shell writes to /data/local/tmp, use the exported path instead. Tap Export in the compatibility hub and point root apps to that path, or switch to root mode for full access.
Make sure the Shizuku service is running, then retry.
❌ Could not deploy the bridge to /data/local/tmp.\n\n%1$s%2$s
⚠️ did not complete end-to-end; exec-style apps may fail here:\n%1$s
Root-level bridge: apps needing true root can work through it.
Shell-level bridge (like ADB): features needing only shell/ADB can work. Features requiring true root, such as reading another app\'s private data, cannot work even if the app detects root.
\n\nThe calling app must be authorized in Shizuku+ before its commands through the bridge can succeed.
